description_sq:

Sallon i bollshëm së bashku me ambientin e gatimit

description_en: Offered for sale is an apartment with an area of ​​95 m², functionally organized and with natural lighting throughout the day. The apartment is located in a new complex, with contemporary construction standards and regular administration. Organization: Spacious living room with kitchen, direct access to the balcony, 2 comfortable bedrooms, 1 bathroom in the master bedroom, 1 living room, distribution corridor
